faqs.q: Which is the most haunted place in India?
faqs.a: Bhangarh Fort in the Alwar district of Rajasthan is widely called the most haunted place in India. The 17th century ruins are linked to the legend of a tantrik's curse, and visitors often describe whispers, footsteps and an eerie silence among its crumbling temples and empty streets.

faqs.q: Can you enter Bhangarh Fort at night?
faqs.a: No. The Archaeological Survey of India has put up signboards at Bhangarh Fort warning visitors not to enter before sunrise or after sunset. If you want to see the fort, plan your visit during daylight hours and check the local timings before you go.

faqs.q: What is the story behind Kuldhara village in Rajasthan?
faqs.a: Kuldhara is an abandoned village near Jaisalmer once home to Paliwal Brahmins. Legend says the whole community left overnight, roughly two centuries ago, after a local minister threatened to forcibly marry the chief's daughter, and cursed the land so no one could settle there again. Today it is a quiet ghost village of empty stone houses.

faqs.q: Is it safe to visit haunted places in India?
faqs.a: Most well-known haunted sites are safe to visit during the day if you follow local rules and timings. Go with a local guide, carry a torch, water and comfortable shoes for uneven ground, avoid isolated spots after dark and stay respectful of local beliefs and communities.
